natural_language_statement: For every natural number $m$ and real $v>0$, the translation count $T_m(v,H)$ has polynomial growth of degree $2m+1$, hence $$\frac{\log T_m(v,H)}{H}\longrightarrow 0$$ as $H\to+\infty$. The source proof first establishes the positive normalized limit $T_m(v,H)/H^{2m+1}\to 1/v$ from the floor-count limits and then applies the accepted logarithm-of-polynomial-growth theorem.
theorem_title: Negligible logarithmic growth of the translation count
